about: v3: what people say to a desk lamp, labelled by the routing policy in policy.md (rules P1-P8, each case names its rule). expect answer: the voice answers itself; with acts, a function of that class must be the first call (light, timer, reminder, volume, memory, time, weather, search, skill). expect hand_over: doors lists every door that passes for the first call: ask (ask_agent), task (start_agent_task), answer (no hand-over call). New fields: rule, pre (face: a known face in view; after:<id>: that case first), new (true on ids 101 and up). Ids 1-100 keep v2's ask text. Assumes the second route with LAMP_HARD_ASKS_TO_AGENT on. See README.md.
